.pbxproj.reason: Xcode serializes project structure in OpenStep property-list form; formatting this generated metadata creates broad churn.
.pbxproj.validation: plutil -lint and the required xcodebuild jobs parse the project.

.xcscheme.reason: Shared Xcode schemes are serialized build/test metadata rather than source code.
.xcscheme.validation: The required xcodebuild jobs resolve and execute the named schemes.

.xcworkspacedata.reason: Xcode owns the workspace membership serialization.
.xcworkspacedata.validation: The required xcodebuild workspace build parses this file.

pnpm-lock.yaml.reason: Generated dependency-resolution data; its serialized order is owned by pnpm.

apps/mobile/ios/Podfile.lock.reason: Generated dependency-resolution data; its serialized order is owned by CocoaPods.
apps/mobile/ios/Podfile.lock.validation: pod install --deployment and the required iOS build

apps/mobile/ios/OrotMobile.xcworkspace/x.reason: Swift Package Manager resolution snapshot, not hand-authored source.
apps/mobile/ios/OrotMobile.xcworkspace/x.validation: The required xcodebuild job resolves the workspace packages.

packages/provider-openai/Package.resolve.reason: Swift Package Manager resolution snapshot, not hand-authored source.

packages/provider-openai/ios-spike/ChatG.reason: Swift Package Manager resolution snapshot, not hand-authored source.
packages/provider-openai/ios-spike/ChatG.validation: The required iOS Simulator Build job resolves the standalone package.

scripts/quality/Gemfile.lock.reason: Generated Ruby gem resolution data, pinned by Bundler rather than a formatter.

apps/mobile/android/gradle/wrapper/gradl.reason: Binary Gradle wrapper supplied by the upstream wrapper generator.
apps/mobile/android/gradle/wrapper/gradl.validation: ./apps/mobile/android/gradlew --version and the pinned distribution URL in gradle-wrapper.properties

apps/mobile/android/gradlew.reason: Generated Gradle wrapper launcher; keep it paired with its upstream wrapper JAR.

apps/mobile/android/gradlew.bat.reason: Generated Windows Gradle wrapper launcher; keep it paired with its upstream wrapper JAR.
apps/mobile/android/gradlew.bat.validation: The Gradle wrapper JAR and pinned distribution are validated by the Mac wrapper invocation.

apps/mobile/android/app/debug.keystore.reason: Binary debug signing key; never pass key material to text formatters or linters.
apps/mobile/android/app/debug.keystore.validation: Android debug signing consumes this file when an Android build is run.

apps/mobile/android/app/proguard-rules.p.reason: This tracked ProGuard file currently contains only comments and no executable rules.
apps/mobile/android/app/proguard-rules.p.validation: The selector fails if an active rule is added; the Android Gradle build parses active rules.

apps/mobile/android/gradle/wrapper/gradl.reason: Generated Gradle wrapper metadata; the upstream wrapper owns its distribution settings.

apps/mobile/.env.reason: Local environment/secret configuration is not committed source and must not be read.
apps/mobile/.env.validation: CI injects its environment explicitly; local values remain outside the quality scan.

nonCodeExtensions..md: Human-authored documentation, outside the maintained-code lint/format scope.
nonCodeExtensions..png: Binary image asset; text formatters cannot parse pixels.
nonCodeExtensions..jpg: Binary image asset; text formatters cannot parse pixels.
nonCodeExtensions..jpeg: Binary image asset; text formatters cannot parse pixels.
nonCodeExtensions..jar: Binary dependency or wrapper artifact, not source text.
nonCodeExtensions..keystore: Binary signing material, not source text.

nonCodePathRules.reason: Generated logs written by the CI quality command wrapper, not maintained source.

nonCodeBasenames..gitignore: Git path-selection configuration has no language formatter.
nonCodeBasenames..gitattributes: Git attributes are line-oriented repository metadata, not source code.
nonCodeBasenames..nvmrc: Single-version runtime selector; setup-node reads and validates it directly.
nonCodeBasenames..editorconfig: Editor defaults consumed directly by language tools and editors.
nonCodeBasenames..swiftformat: SwiftFormat's own configuration, consumed directly by SwiftFormat.
nonCodeBasenames..clang-format: clang-format's own configuration, consumed directly by clang-format.
nonCodeBasenames.LICENSE: License terms are legal text rather than maintained executable code.
